properties.description: Compact single-column Fields / Additional relations split. Help between name and type; reusable value frame. Intra-field border plus comment, inter-field colored edges with tooltip, neutral gray links; connected ordering preserves declaration order and overlapping groups. Relation fields, read-only provenance and inherited/overridden priority are visible. No predicate source viewer for MVP.
properties.title: Deliver truthful node editing with visible invariant feedback
